title: Add behavioral cases isolating forward-revision root and authority guards
outcome: Behavioral coverage distinguishes the revision-only Bound-root and settled-authority guards from pre-existing proof and preparation refusals, without source-text tests.
acceptance: A settled forward-revision case with an unnamed or released cached root refuses refresh and creates no later named sighting.
Coverage isolates the settled-authority precondition where practical, and the same-root check is assessed as defense in depth against the existing root_matches and still_current guards.
